correctness.rationale: PASS: For each distinct target word, left-to-right greedy matching gives independent geometric waiting times with factor g_a(z)=p_a*z/(1-(1-p_a)*z). Weighted Möbius inversion of primitive word rotation orbits gives the Lyndon multivariate Witt logarithm. With all p_a positive, S1(r)=1 has unique r in (0,1), d>=2 necklace terms are analytic beyond r, and positivity and strict triangle inequality isolate a unique dominant log singularity. This gives the coefficient prefactor 1/((1-r)n); summing arbitrary patterns gives the simple-pole comparison and ratio r*S1prime(r)/n. Strict concavity in p of g_a(z) yields Schur-concavity and unique uniform max. Independent exact direct random-word enumeration versus greedy target-pattern summation agreed for two binary distributions n<=8 and one ternary n<=6. Boundary p_a=0 expressly excluded.
